EN: Oh! Easy there! The other specimens have resisted my treatments.
ZH: 哦！别紧张！其他样本都抵御了我的改造。

EN: These two individuals have shown some sign of potential for social serenity.
ZH: 这两个个体表现出了一定程度的冷静和社会性。

EN: Please, lower your arms, you have nothing to fear from them!
ZH: 请放下武器，你们不用害怕他们！

EN: No! My babies!
ZH: 不！我的孩子们！

EN: They are! And I hope to convert more to such behaviour. Please see yourselves out, I have much more work to do!
ZH: 没错！我希望更多的死爪能变成这样。快走吧，我还有很多工作要做！

EN: Of course! My chance of survival would be utterly infinitesimal! But I trust science! And my two friends here.
ZH: 当然怕！在它们的爪子下，我的生存机会微乎其微！但我相信科学！我还有两个朋友呢。

EN: You can't tame a deathclaw. Get out of the way, we'll take care of them.
ZH: 死爪是没法驯服的。让开，我们会处理它们。

EN: Wow. They really are just kinda chilling out!
ZH: 哇，他们真的相当放松！

EN: Aren't you afraid they might turn on you?
ZH: 你不怕它们会攻击你吗？

EN: Well, ok then. You seem ok, so we're going to go. Good luck!
ZH: 好吧，你看起来状态还不错。那我们走了，祝你好运！

EN: Some of our foragers talked to a traveller recently who claimed he was looking for a colony of death claws in the area on which he planned to conduct "social experiments." They're worried he might be just taking a circuitous rout to getting himself eaten. Go to this area nearby where Deathclaws are known to gather and see if you can save the poor fool from himself.
ZH: 我们的几个采集者最近和一个旅行者聊天，他说他正在该地区寻找死爪聚集地，还计划在那里进行“社会实验”。他们担心他可能会自讨苦吃。去附近这个死爪聚集地，看看能不能救救这个可怜的家伙。

EN: A Dearth of Claws
ZH: 缺爪之痛

EN: Find the deathclaw scientist.
ZH: 找到死爪科学家。

EN: Find the would-be deathclaw scientist.
ZH: 找到那个想研究死爪的科学家。

EN: Hmm, where's the Overseer?
ZH: 嗯，监督者在哪里？

EN: She must be waiting for us on one of the upper floors.
ZH: 她一定在楼上的某个地方等我们。

EN: Listen! Three Dog's on the air.
ZH: 听！三狗正在直播。

EN: He's telling everyone where all the cults are so Settlers can steer clear of them!
ZH: 他正在告诉大家各个邪教都在什么地方，这样能方便定居者们避开他们！

EN: Keep fighting the Good Fight, Three Dog.
ZH: 继续打好仗，三狗。

EN: But it won't matter if we can't stop the Horsemen. Let's find this Overseer!
ZH: 但如果我们不能阻止骑士的话就没所谓了。我们去找监督者吧！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: No, not at all. I was going to say... uh... oh, whatever. We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 不，一点都不。我正要说……呃……哦，无所谓了。我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: The shadow of Death, as defined in Article 8, Subsection c, is upon you!
ZH: 死亡的阴影，如第8条第c款所定义的，就在你身上！

EN: Death will awaken when the quota is met. It's all there in the Manual.
ZH: 当配额满足时“死亡”就会苏醒。手册里都写了。

EN: So we spill your blood today not out of malice, but to help meet that quota.
ZH: 所以我们今天让你们流血不是出于恶意，而是为了凑够那个配额。

EN: We hope your final moments meet the Manual's minimum happiness requirements.
ZH: 我们希望您最后的时刻幸福度能满足手册的最低要求。

EN: The Death cultitsts are Dwellers from Vault 144? I did not see that coming.
ZH: “死亡”教徒是来自144号避难所的居民吗？这我还真没料到。

EN: Can you at least tell us where Death is first? You know we'll find out eventually.
ZH: 你能至少告诉我们“死亡”在哪里吗？你知道我们最终会发现的。

EN: So Death is sleeping and you're killing people to wake him up. That isn't insane at all.
ZH: 所以“死亡”正在睡觉，你杀了人来叫醒他。这一点都不疯狂。

EN: You're about to shout out your cult motto, aren't you?
ZH: 你要喊出你的邪教座右铭，是不是？

EN: In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As promised, their Overseer contacted us and set up a meeting where she'll tell us what she can! But she doesn't want to reveal the location of her Vault, so we'll be joining her in an abandoned building...
ZH: 在672号避难所，我们遇到了来自144号避难所的居民，他们熟悉那位神秘的第四骑士“死亡”。按照约定，他们的监督者联系了我们并安排了会面，届时她会把她知道的一切都告诉我们！但她不想透露自己避难所的位置，所以我们将会在一座废弃的建筑里与她碰面……

EN: Death Revealed?
ZH: “死亡”出现？

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 144.
ZH: 跟144号避难所的监督者交谈。

EN: Listen to Three Dog's broadcast.
ZH: 听三狗的广播。

EN: Learn the truth about Death from the Overseer of Vault 144!
ZH: 从144号避难所的监督者处了解“死亡”的真相！

EN: Strange, it was sunny before we walked in...
ZH: 奇怪的是，在我们走进去之前，天是晴朗的……

EN: ...and now it's dark outside, with rolling thunder in the distance.
ZH: ……现在外面很黑，远处雷声隆隆。

EN: Very ominous.
ZH: 很不祥。

EN: Okay, but just so you know, we tend to use metric around here.
ZH: 好的，不过提醒你，我们这儿一般用公制。

EN: Eating Cram in the boudoir. I still have the tins if you want to see them.
ZH: 在闺房里吃东西。如果你想看罐头，我还有。

EN: No sir, I don't think so.
ZH: 不，先生，我不这么认为。

EN: I say, we were beginning to worry! I'm Reginald, the head butler.
ZH: 我是雷金纳德，首席管家。

EN: It happened right after the host and guests had retired for the night.
ZH: 此事发生在主人和客人们各自回房就寝之后。

EN: They're waiting for you to question them in the adjacent chambers.
ZH: 他们在等着你在隔壁房间审问他们。

EN: The game is afoot! Let's proceed!
ZH: 游戏正在进行中！让我们继续！

EN: Not so fast. Where were *you* on the night of the murder?
ZH: 没有那么快。谋杀案发生的那天晚上你在哪里？

EN: Reginald, Reginald... Dutch, is it?
ZH: 雷金纳德，雷金纳德……荷兰人，是吗？

EN: We mostly just collect old junk and resell it... but we're very industrious about it!
ZH: 我们通常只是收集旧的垃圾然后转卖……但是我们对此非常勤奋！

EN: Coincidentally enough, trying to find clever ways to murder Mr. Peabody.
ZH: 很巧的是，我当时正在琢磨怎么巧妙地谋杀皮博迪先生。

EN: Don't get any funny ideas! It's bad enough Peabody tried to seduce my wife...
ZH: 不要有任何可笑的想法！皮博迪想勾引我妻子已经够糟的了……

EN: You can't keep us cooped up in here, you know? We have rights!
ZH: 你不能把我们关在这里，知道吗？我们有个人权利！

EN: I'm Rod Murphy, rich but vulgar industrialist, and this is my trophy wife Priscilla.
ZH: 我是罗德·墨菲，富有但粗俗的实业家，这是我的妻子普莉希拉。

EN: We haven't done anything wrong. We certainly didn't *kill* anyone!
ZH: 我们没做错什么。我们当然没有杀任何人！

EN: Not since we got here, anyway...
ZH: 我们当然没杀任何人！反正自从我们来到这里就没杀过人……

EN: An industrialist? In this day and age?
ZH: 一个实业家吗？在这个时代？

EN: What were you doing when Mr. Peabody was murdered?
ZH: 皮博迪先生被谋杀时你在干什么？

EN: I had a cat named Priscilla, once.
ZH: 我曾经养过一只叫普莉希拉的猫。

EN: Got her son addicted to Rock-papers-scissors, then sucked him dry by always picking Rock.
ZH: 是皮博迪让夫人的儿子迷上了剪刀石头布，然后每次出石头，把钱全赢光了。

EN: Oh, she's not a Ghoul, she's just very, very old.
ZH: 哦，她不是尸鬼，她只是非常非常老了。

EN: Resuscitating Lady Worthington after she tried to nibble on a blueberry scone.
ZH: 我在给沃辛顿夫人做急救复苏——她想咬一口蓝莓烤饼，结果噎住了。

EN: Hello! This is Lady Elizabeth Worthington, and I'm her attendant Agatha.
ZH: 你好！这是伊丽莎白·沃辛顿夫人，我是她的侍从阿加莎。

EN: Alas, the Lady can't hear too well, so you'll have to direct your questions to me.
ZH: 唉，那位女士听不太清楚，所以你得直接问我。

EN: The Lady deeply respects Mr. Peabody, whom she's known for years.
ZH: 这位女士非常尊敬皮博迪先生，她认识他很多年了。

EN: She won't even hold a grudge for the fact he basically ruined her family.
ZH: 她甚至不会怨恨他毁了她的家庭。

EN: How did he ruin her family?
ZH: 他怎么毁了她的家庭？

EN: Was that before or after she was Ghoulified?
ZH: 那是在她变成尸鬼之前还是之后？

EN: What were you doing at the time of the murder?
ZH: 谋杀案发生时你在干什么？

EN: I guess it would depend on how much suffering he'd go through first.
ZH: 我想这要看他先受了多少苦。

EN: Sixty-four times, if I recall correctly.
ZH: 64次，如果我没记错的话。

EN: I'm sorry, my niece has a poor memory. I'm sure she can't recall what happened last night.
ZH: 对不起，我侄女记性不好。我肯定她记不起昨晚发生的事了。

EN: Ah, the detective! I am Commodore Tramiel, and this is my niece Vicky.
ZH: 啊，侦探！我是特拉米尔准将，这是我侄女维琪。

EN: So someone finally did old Peabody in, huh? Well, can't say I'm surprised.
ZH: 终于有人把皮博迪干掉了？我一点不惊讶。

EN: The man had lots of enemies! More crooked than a Turkish blade, he was.
ZH: 这个人有很多敌人！他的人格比土耳其弯刀还要扭曲。

EN: If you ask me, the killer deserves a medal. One that could complement this array, here.
ZH: 要我说，凶手真该得一枚勋章——正好配我这一排。

EN: Are you saying you wanted him dead?
ZH: 你是说你想让他死？

EN: Turkish blade, huh? Did you know Peabody was stabbed to death?
ZH: 土耳其弯刀，是吧？你知道皮博迪是被刺死的吗？

EN: What about you, Vicky? Did you see anything?
ZH: 你呢，维琪？你看到什么了吗？

EN: Only when I go on a violent rampage, so...every other week, maybe?
ZH: 只有当我暴跳如雷的时候，所以……也许每隔一周？

EN: Oh sure! He'd disown me, I'd thrust sharp objects at him... The usual.
ZH: 哦，当然！他会和我断绝关系，我会用锋利的东西戳他……没什么大不了的。

EN: All my siblings met grisly fates, usually when playing by the cliffside.
ZH: 我所有的兄弟姐妹都遭遇了可怕的命运，通常是在悬崖边玩耍的时候。

EN: I'll remember that next time I go on a violent, murderous rampage.
ZH: 我将记住这一点，下一次我将进行暴力的、血腥的暴行。

EN: Hello! I'm Alvin Peabody, sole heir to my father's baseball card fortune.
ZH: 你好！我是阿尔文·皮博迪，我父亲棒球卡财产的唯一继承人。

EN: I'm afraid I won't be of much help, I have no memory of last night.
ZH: 我恐怕帮不了你的忙，我对昨晚的事已记不得了。

EN: All I know is I woke up this morning with a bloody dagger in my hand.
ZH: 我只知道今天早上我醒来时手里拿着一把血淋淋的匕首。

EN: Father would know, I kind of remember him screaming my name.
ZH: 父亲会知道的，我记得他喊叫着我的名字。

EN: Do you often suffer such memory losses?
ZH: 你经常遭受这样的失忆吗？

EN: Did you get along well with your father?
ZH: 你和你父亲相处得好吗？

EN: You're the only heir?
ZH: 你是唯一的继承人？

EN: I must say I appreciate your candor.
ZH: 我得说我很欣赏你的坦率。

EN: Not surprised, you can never trust the “nouveau riche.”
ZH: 这并不奇怪，你永远不能相信“暴发户”。

EN: Huh. Who knew such a monster hid behind those thick nerdy glasses?
ZH: 嗯。谁知道在那些厚实的书呆子眼镜后面竟然藏着这么一个怪物？

EN: I guess it all adds up. Here, Mr. Peabody would have wanted you to have this.
ZH: 我想这一切都说明了问题。这里，皮博迪先生想让你拿到这个。

EN: Strangely enough, he's the one who sent for you. Guess he didn't think this through.
ZH: 奇怪的是，是他叫你来的。我猜他没有想清楚。

EN: So, did you find out who did it?
ZH: 你知道是谁干的吗？

EN: Was it the jealous industrialist, or the ruined matriarch?
ZH: 是嫉妒的实业家，还是被毁的女家长？

EN: Perhaps it was the retired soldier, or Peabody's psychotic son?
ZH: 也许是退役士兵，或者是皮博迪的精神病儿子？

EN: Please tell us, we all took bets.
ZH: 请告诉我们，我们出过赌注了。

EN: It was Rod Murphy, the industrialist.
ZH: 是实业家罗德·墨菲。

EN: Lady Worthington's attendant Agatha did it.
ZH: 沃辛顿夫人的随从阿加莎干的。

EN: The Commodore is the murderer.
ZH: 准将就是凶手。

EN: It's obviously his son. You didn't need me for that.
ZH: 很明显是他的儿子。你不需要我告诉你这点。

EN: Egads! We've just received word that William Peabody III, Esq., has been found murdered in his bedchambers. We must send our brightest detective and his trusty sidekick to solve this gruesome mystery!
ZH: 天哪！我们刚刚得到消息，威廉·皮博迪三世先生被发现死在他的卧室里。我们必须派我们最聪明的侦探和他值得信赖的助手去解开这个可怕的谜团！

EN: Death and Denial
ZH: 死亡和否定

EN: Solve the Murder of William Peabody.
ZH: 解决威廉·皮博迪谋杀案。

EN: Interrogate first group of suspects.
ZH: 审讯第一组嫌疑犯。

EN: Interrogate second group of suspects.
ZH: 审问第二组嫌疑人。

EN: Solve a murder mystery.
ZH: 解决一个谋杀之谜。

EN: This “manor” has seen better times...
ZH: 这个“庄园”早已破落……

EN: You just can't get good help these days.
ZH: 这些天你就是找不到好帮手。

EN: Our new dog is acting worried. What is it, boy? You want us to follow? Maybe it's delicious food, like Cram, or Brahmin steak, or… Deathclaw meat!
ZH: 我们的新狗狗看起来很担心。怎么了，小家伙？你想让我们跟着你走？也许是有什么好吃的，比如饱饱牌肉罐头，或者双头牛肉排，或者……死爪肉！

EN: Death Meat
ZH: 死爪肉

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。

EN: Follow the dog back to Novac… what could be waiting for us there?
ZH: 跟着狗狗回到诺瓦克……那里等着我们的是什么？

EN: What are these Deathclaws doing at our motel?
ZH: 这些死爪在我们旅馆里干什么？

EN: Well, they're no good for business. Gotta kick em out.
ZH: 嗯，它们对生意不好。得把它们赶走。

EN: Doesn't hurt to ask!
ZH: 问问也无妨！

EN: Gee, that would be bad. At least let's go check their intestines for keys.
ZH: 哎呀，那可糟了。至少去检查一下它们的肠子里有没有钥匙。

EN: Maybe they just wanted a room.
ZH: 也许它们只是想订个房间。

EN: I wonder if they would pay rent.
ZH: 不知道它们愿不愿意交房租。

EN: I hope they didn't eat any clients.
ZH: 希望它们没有把客人吃掉。

EN: ROOOOOAAARR!
ZH: 吼嗷！

EN: Grawrrrarlllgr!
ZH: 嘎嗷嗷！

EN: That'll be our Alpha. Nobody get beheaded!
ZH: 那就是头头了。谁都别被砍头！

EN: Oh, hey, a ribcage. Looks fresh. Yikes.
ZH: 哦，嘿，一个肋骨架。看起来很新鲜。吓人。

EN: This is not great for our public image as a safe place to stay.
ZH: 这对我们作为安全住宿场所的公众形象非常不利。

EN: Don't interfere! We need medicine!
ZH: 别妨碍我们！我们需要药！

EN: Something will have to be done about those Deathclaws! Apparently there's a doctor who can make a strong poison that will keep them away for good. Let's go talk to her!
ZH: 必须对这些死爪采取点行动了！显然有个医生能调制一种强效毒药，可以让它们永远不再靠近。去跟她谈谈吧！

EN: Fetch Quest
ZH: 跑腿任务

EN: Talk to Doc
ZH: 与医生交谈。

EN: Talk to a doctor about a Deathclaw pesticide.
ZH: 和一位医生交谈关于死爪驱虫剂的问题。

EN: I don't know who you are… but you have to help! We're being raided!
ZH: 我不认识你……但你一定要帮我们！我们被袭击了！

EN: Oh, thank you! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere… please hurry!
ZH: 谢谢你！我们的医生在楼上某处……请快点！

EN: I know, right? Please do what you can! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere!
ZH: 就是！请尽力而为！我们的医生在楼上某处！

EN: Oh, yeah, you look tough! Go get 'em!
ZH: 哦，是啊，你们看起来挺强的！去给他们点颜色看看！

EN: We'll take care of it. If you take care of us.
ZH: 我们来处理，你来照顾我们。

EN: Those raider scum! In a house of science?!
ZH: 那帮掠夺者！在科学殿堂？！

EN: Don't worry. We'll take them down.
ZH: 别担心。我们会搞定他们。

EN: Ah! They finally found me… I guess you'll want to…
ZH: 啊！他们终于找到我了……我想你们是要……

EN: Oh, you're not raiders. What, uh... can I do for you?
ZH: 哦，你不是掠夺者。嗯，有什么……我能帮你？

EN: Oh, sure. Just use this poison on every egg you see and kill the adults. Should be easy for you!
ZH: 哦，当然。就用这种毒药喷在你看到的每个蛋上，然后杀掉成年的。对你来说应该很容易！

EN: Oh, dear. Sounds serious. You'll have to kill the Alphas, and use this poison on their eggs. Good luck!
ZH: 哦，亲爱的。听起来很严重。你需要杀掉头头，然后用这种毒药喷在它们的蛋上。祝你好运！

EN: You got anything to deal with Deathclaws?
ZH: 你有什么对付死爪的东西吗？

EN: Doctor, we've got a case of the Deathclaws.
ZH: 医生，我们感染了死爪。

EN: Anybody here? Isn't this supposed to be a bustling science hub?
ZH: 有人在吗？这里不是应该是个热闹的科学中心吗？

EN: I hope we can find our Deathclaw expert here…
ZH: 希望我们能在这里找到我们的死爪专家……

EN: Now we have some Deathclaw poison. I guess we should spray the nest near the motel to get rid of the problem, rather than the motel itself.
ZH: 现在我们有了死爪毒药。我想我们应该去喷洒旅馆附近的巢穴来根治问题，而不是喷旅馆本身。

EN: Deathicide
ZH: 死爪灭除

EN: Spray the Deathclaw nest
ZH: 喷洒死爪巢穴。

EN: Kill the adult Deathclaws (1/2)
ZH: 消灭成年死爪（1/2）。

EN: Kill the adult Deathclaws (2/2)
ZH: 消灭成年死爪（2/2）。

EN: Spray the Deathclaw nest with poison.
ZH: 用毒药喷洒死爪巢穴。

EN: Humans. Pray, do not attack me. I do not share the violent tendancy of my brethren.
ZH: 人类。请不要攻击我。我不像我的同类那样好斗。

EN: I have been a voluntary prisoner here, for the sin of desiring a less violent lifestyle for my people.
ZH: 因为向往和平生活，我在这里自愿成为囚犯，为我同族的罪愆受罚。

EN: Now, I am free. What compelled you to this savage place?
ZH: 现在，我自由了。是什么让你来到这个蛮荒之地？

EN: And you are here to exterminate them, no doubt. I do not begrudge you. They could not be reasoned with.
ZH: 你们无疑是来消灭它们的。我不怪你。它们无法以理服之。

EN: Do not fret, I will not stop you. I will look for more like me, who seek peace, and likely die alone.
ZH: 别担心，我不会阻止你们。我会去寻找和我一样追求和平的同类，然后大概孤独地死去。

EN: Ah. Humans are no different, after all. I am the last of your foes. Now perish!
ZH: 啊。原来人类没什么不同。我是你最后一个敌人。现在，去死吧！

EN: Your, uh, brethren attacked our motel.
ZH: 你的，嗯，同类袭击了我们的旅馆。

EN: Killing your family and poisoning your eggs?
ZH: 杀你家人，毒你的蛋？

EN: Dealing with pests, and you're one of them!
ZH: 对付害虫的，你就是其中之一！

EN: It's the Deathclaw eggs… how should we do this?
ZH: 这是死爪的蛋……我们该怎么处理？

EN: Surgical precision!
ZH: 外科手术级别的精准！

EN: EXTERMINATE!!!
ZH: 消灭！！！

EN: <Carefully spray only the eggs>
ZH: <仔细喷洒蛋>

EN: <Wildly spray the whole room>
ZH: <疯狂喷洒整个房间>

EN: Room please!
ZH: 订房！

EN: This decor is horrible!
ZH: 这装修真是难看！

EN: Hungry! Hungry!!!
ZH: 饿！好饿！！！

EN: Apparently our anti-Deathclaw spray is like honey to feral Ghouls. Clear them out so we can get running again!
ZH: 显然我们的死爪驱虫剂对狂尸鬼就像蜂蜜一样有吸引力。把他们清掉，旅馆才能重新运营！

EN: Ghoul Down, Boy
ZH: 尸鬼，趴下！

EN: Clear out the feral Ghouls
ZH: 清除那些狂尸鬼。

EN: Clear feral Ghouls out of the motel so it can run again.
ZH: 清除旅馆里的狂尸鬼以便重新营业。

EN: AAAUGH NO PLEASE DON'T- oh, it's you. Wow!
ZH: 啊啊啊求求你别——哦，是你。哇！

EN: I have to say, Some of our clients are pretty aggressive! I want hazard pay!
ZH: 不得不说，我们有些客人还挺凶的！我要额外的危险津贴！

EN: What?! I… well, you make a good point. Here, it's all I've got on me. Let's call it even.
ZH: 什么？！我……嗯，你说得有道理。来，这是我身上所有的。两清了。

EN: Ugh. You're right, of course. All right, back to work, I suppose…
ZH: 唉，你说得对。好吧，看来我得继续回去工作了……

EN: Fine! I will! … Ah, who am I kidding? I got nowhere else to go.
ZH: 好！我去！……唉，我又能上哪儿呢？

EN: I saved you. You should pay me.
ZH: 我救了你，你该付钱给我。
